grains.RAW.TOOLS: one fab tool per ID; 24 synthetic tools (plasma etchers, CVD chambers, wire bonders, wafer probers) at 5 fictional Malaysian sites, with HASH-seeded age, class, reliability, loading and PM profile
grains.RAW.SENSOR_READINGS: one tool-day per ENTITY_ID and EVENT_DATE; daily aggregates, not individual sensor packets
grains.RAW.SPARE_PARTS: one required critical spare type per tool at snapshot date
grains.CURATED.PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY: one tool over the entire 90-day observation window
grains.CURATED.TREND_ANALYSIS: one day across all fab tools
grains.ML.FAILURE_RISK_SCORES: one tool scored on its latest observation day
grains.RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY: one simulated tool reading, from APP.SIMULATE_TELEMETRY or an IoT Core message loaded by Snowpipe
grains.ML.VIBRATION_ANOMALIES: one tool-day in the last 15 days, scored against the prior 75-day baseline

mean_time_between_downs_hours.zero_failures: null; not an infinite or zero MTBF estimate

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation
required_capabilities.remaining_useful_life_model: REPLACED by a 7-day down-risk classifier (no run-to-failure history), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout against the base rate
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day fab-wide downtime FORECAST; pump vibration ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.MAINTENANCE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic SOPs (one per tool class and failure mode)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: semantic view APP.MAINTENANCE_ANALYTICS (downs by root cause sum to the Unscheduled Downs KPI) and Cortex Agent APP.MAINTENANCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; action memo by Cortex AI_COMPLETE (snowflake build) or Amazon Bedrock Claude via external-access UDF APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE (aws build)
required_capabilities.quicksight: AWS build: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (tool count, daily availability, downtime by tool, down risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: AWS build: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.native_ingestion: Snowflake build: APP.SIMULATE_TELEMETRY(n) and optional suspended task APP.TASK_SIMULATE_TELEMETRY insert into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY

snowflake.capabilities: core, ML, search, semantic view, agent, alert, task graph, native telemetry and SPCS app with Cortex memo
